name: ShowMyAura Portfolio Showcase
author: Devgurux

sections.description:
ShowMyAura Portfolio Showcase is a professional WordPress plugin for artists, developers, photographers, and agencies to showcase their work in stunning, modern gallery layouts.

3 Gallery Layouts

  • Smart Masonry — True Pinterest-style variable-height columns. Tall portrait images show the top portion; hovering automatically scrolls the image from top to bottom at a smooth, configurable speed. Click any image to open the lightbox.
  • Swipe Slider — Full Swiper carousel with the image on the left and project details on the right. Touch-enabled, autoplay, keyboard navigation. Tall images auto-scroll on hover.
  • Spotlight Grid — Clean responsive grid with a bold gradient spotlight overlay on hover. Title and tags slide up. Click opens lightbox.

Key Features

  • 1 gallery with unlimited projects
  • Lightbox with image auto-scroll — tall images show the top by default; hovering scrolls them to the bottom
  • Configurable scroll speed (1–12 seconds)
  • Curtain hover effect with adjustable default and hover opacity
  • Dark / Light mode per gallery
  • 6 gradient color themes
  • Category filter buttons above the gallery
  • Support for images, video (mp4, webm, ogg), and audio (mp3, wav)
  • Fully mobile responsive — all layouts adapt to any screen size
  • Keyboard and swipe navigation in lightbox

Pro Version

The Pro version is available separately at https://plugins.devgurux.com/ and adds:

  • Multiple galleries
  • 12 additional gallery layouts (15 total)
  • Real-time analytics dashboard
  • Social interaction buttons
  • Import / Export galleries
  • Remove branding
  • Custom colors
  • Priority support

Additional Info

Plugin page: https://plugins.devgurux.com/
Support: contact@devgurux.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ShowMyAura in the admin menu
  4. Edit your gallery, add projects, and choose a layout
  5. Paste [ShowMyAura gallery_id="X"] on any page or post
sections.faq:
How do I display the gallery?

Use the shortcode [ShowMyAura gallery_id="X"] — find the ID in the gallery list or the edit screen.

How does the image auto-scroll work?

For tall portrait images, only the top portion is visible initially. When a user hovers over the image, it smoothly scrolls to reveal the full image from top to bottom. The scroll speed is configurable in Gallery Settings.

How many projects can I add?

Unlimited. There is no project limit in the free version.

Is the gallery mobile responsive?

Yes. All three layouts adapt to any screen size. Masonry becomes a single column on mobile, Slider stacks image and details vertically, and Spotlight Grid adjusts column count automatically.

Can I use it for videos?

Yes. Enter any mp4, webm, or ogg URL as the project image. Videos autoplay on hover in the gallery and play with controls in the lightbox.
